standing: PROVISIONAL. These are M-C candidates tested by the corrected incumbent against a declared opponent panel. No rating is published and no strength claim is made.
ratingsNote: Ratings stay off because this evidence does not support one: the opposition is a small, adaptively reused TRAINING panel, so a number here would read as a strength claim the games cannot carry. The games themselves are policy-qualified; it is the comparison that is narrow. A blank rating is a decision, not a gap in the data.

opposition.basis: two reference opponents are identical in every generation and two rotate, so only the reference record is comparable across generations. Every team here is TRAINING opposition whose results teach later generations - none of it is independent evaluation.

referenceCohort.basis: 2 reference identities, weighted equally at 0.500 each. The score is the WEIGHTED MEAN of the per-reference rates, not a pooled rate: an unbalanced exposure must not let the more-played reference decide the number.

recovery.basis: a projection that does not describe its bundle is refused, and a contender whose rows contradict each other is withheld entirely rather than merged under one of them. Candidate records publish either way.

ordering.basis: the two fixed reference opponents are the only exposure every generation shares, so they are what the order rests on. Rows without reference evidence are listed after it and marked unranked. Pooled win rate is NOT used, as an order or as a tie-break, because it mixes opposition that differs between generations.
ordering.notEvidenceFor: a rating, a universal ranking, or a claim that the top row is the strongest team. It is a narrow training comparison on a shared exposure.

counts.basis: uniqueQualifiedMatches counts the games that were played, from the committed game counts. contenderPerspectives sums the per-card records, which is larger whenever both teams of a game have a card: recoveredPerspectives is how much of that difference came from reading the other seat of games already played.

historicalBoard.status: preserved as history; it is a different regulation and a different player
historicalBoard.note: An M-B result cannot become a current M-C standing. The M-B board remains available and is not republished here.
